fundamental.summary: CHD shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 16 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (358.6), flat yield curve, rising dollar, imminent CPI event (0 days), and earnings in 16 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for CHD.
